title: IA Mapping Row
description: One proposed or reviewed mapping from a source field to a target L2 entity attribute. The CSV is simultaneously build configuration, a review surface, and a provenance record.

mapping_id.description: MAP-<SUBJECT_ABBR>-NNNN. Stable for the life of the row.

target_attribute.description: Attribute on the target entity, snake_case.

target_grain.description: One row per what. Must be identical across all rows for a given target_entity.

source_system.description: System of record, matching the discovery source index.

source_object.description: Table, file, API resource, or report.

source_field.description: Field or expression at the source.

join_key.description: Key used to relate this source to the target entity grain. Blank where the source is already at grain.

transform_rule.description: Deterministic rule in the ETL framework's expression syntax. Prose here is a defect — it cannot be built from.

cde_flag.description: Critical Data Element. Drives quality monitoring.

dq_rule.description: Declared quality expectations, semicolon-separated. e.g. 'not null; unique within source_system'.

status.description: Only 'approved' rows are consumed by the build. Rejected and deferred rows are retained as a record.

reviewer.description: Named human who made the status decision.

notes.description: Rationale. For rejected and deferred rows this is mandatory in practice — it is what prevents the mapping being re-proposed.

agent_confidence.description: Agent's confidence at proposal time. Never edited after review — it is a record of what the agent claimed, not of what is true.

agent_run_id.description: Resolves to a prompt version in agents/ia-mapping/CHANGELOG.md. Use 'human' for rows authored directly.
